learning_outcomes.text: Students can characterize the functionality and application areas of the treated connection types.
Students are able to select suitable connection types for technical tasks. They can dimension the treated connections statically or dynamically depending on the stresses that occur.

Within the project tasks, students can independently carry out simple design tasks using the treated connection types, taking into account sustainability aspects and performing corresponding dimensioning in accordance with existing guidelines or standards.

syllabus_topics: Screw connections, function and effect, design guidelines, calculation of screw connections
Calculation of welded connections, strength verification according to DIN 15018
Project tasks in construction and calculation related to the treated machine elements
teaching_methods: Independent work on constructive and computational project tasks in small groups
assessment_rules: The examination form (exam and/or project work) will be announced at the beginning of the lecture. Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination. The grade is weighted according to credit points.
